N_religious_exempt.long_name: Number of students with a religious vaccination exemption
N_religious_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines.
N_religious_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students holding a religious exemption. Reported by states that separate religious exemptions from other non-medical exemptions.
N_religious_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

N_medical_exempt.long_name: Number of students with a medical vaccination exemption
N_medical_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with a medical exemption from vaccination requirements.
N_medical_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. Reported by some states and left missing where the source publishes only percentages.
N_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

N_full_exempt.long_name: Number of students with any vaccination exemption
N_full_exempt.short_description: Number of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
N_full_exempt.long_description: Count of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, combining medical and non-medical exemptions. Reported by some states and left missing where the source publishes only percentages.
N_full_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.

rate_religious_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a religious vaccination exemption
rate_religious_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a religious exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_religious_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a religious exemption. Reported by states that separate religious exemptions from other non-medical (philosophical or personal-belief) exemptions.
rate_religious_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a religious vaccination exemption.

rate_medical_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
rate_medical_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
rate_medical_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey.
rate_medical_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

rate_full_exempt.long_name: Proportion of students with any vaccination exemption
rate_full_exempt.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with any exemption (medical or non-medical) from vaccination requirements.
rate_full_exempt.long_description: Share of assessed school students with at least one vaccination exemption of any type, combining medical and non-medical exemptions. Where a state reports the categories separately this is their sum; overlap handling depends on what the source publishes.
rate_full_exempt.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a vaccination exemption of any kind.

N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
N_enrolled.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

nc_school_immunization.name: North Carolina Kindergarten Immunization Data
nc_school_immunization.organization: North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services
nc_school_immunization.description: County-level kindergarten immunization coverage and exemption data from the NC DPH kindergarten dashboard.
nc_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
